checked: Oklahoma State University Kappler text: Sept. 3, 1839, 7 Stat. 580 and 11 Stat. 577, proclaimed May 16, 1840; east half (23,040 acres) of the 46,080-acre tract at $1 an acre; $8,767.75 plus $3,879.30 = $12,647.05 stated in Art. 3; $10,392.95 balance, $6,000 school fund at 5 per cent and $4,392.95 to the sachem; paid in one year; removal and a year's subsistence. Matches.

Docket 300 findings (OSU 1947) opened: Finding 5 states $12,633.47 disbursed of $12,647.05, $13.58 due, and $378.08 of the Article 4 investment unaccounted for and due; Finding 6 rejects the $12,283.08 surplus claim and gives $14,042.50 spent on removal and subsistence; Finding 17 itemises $391.66 for this treaty in $4,203.09. The money is this treaty's.

Final award (OSU 1453): $4,203.09, affirmed by the Court of Claims Jan. 29, 1973 in Appeal No. 7-72, entered May 30, 1973. Matches. The award was decided on the merits, not settled, so claims-commission is right.
